story.heading: A Little About My Journey
paragraphs: I'm a **Digital Business student** at BINUS University @Semarang, with a focus on **UI/UX and visual design**.

My design journey started in **2019**. I began with **graphic design** and, over time, grew into creating intuitive app and website interfaces in **Figma**. Through the projects I've worked on, I've built strong skills in prototyping, visual design, and user-focused thinking.

Alongside design, I've been building a second side: **analysis**. I built a machine learning system that predicts machine failure, designed an n8n workflow to automate order fulfillment for a smart aquaculture startup, and worked in a four-person team on research about AI-integrated learning, including preparing the manuscript.
What ties it together is what I enjoy most: **turning ideas into clear, functional digital experiences**. And I'm always up for a chat.
